$doc: DREDD'S MEMBER BENCH - the member-facing capabilities: what a member HAS, not what to run for an ask (that is bench.json, the instruments). Each row carries `jev` (the yes/no question Jev answers about the ask, same contract as an instrument's jev), `keywords` (the same question answered by the ask's own words when Jev is unreachable), `setting` (the EXACT constant, dial or table that governs the capability - the number a member's question is really about, with file:line), `capability` (its row in infra/shared/plane-capabilities.json - the declaration that a plane actually HAS this) and `owner` (the declaring plane). tests/member-bench.spec.mjs fails the moment a row names a capability no plane declares, so this roster can never drift ahead of the inventory it cites.

capabilities.name: Login - the email one-time-code
capabilities.what: How a member signs in: an email one-time-code is the primary login factor, driven through a Cognito custom auth challenge. There are no passwords.
capabilities.jev: Is the ask about a member signing in - the email one-time-code itself, its expiry or resend throttle, or being locked out - rather than about anything that sits behind the sign-in?
capabilities.setting: A 6-digit zero-padded random code (generateOtpCode, infra/shared/otp.ts:11), minted and verified through accounts' Cognito custom-auth challenge triad (define/create/verify-auth-challenge, services/accounts/lambda/src/). No password exists anywhere in the flow.

capabilities.name: Data Locker - the per-user size
capabilities.what: One settings JSON per (member, app): a developer picks each app's per-user size as a whole number of 64 KB units (64, 128 or 256 KB). A write past max_bytes is refused 413; a new person at a full free pool is refused 402 app_pool_full and everyone who already wrote keeps writing.
capabilities.jev: Is the ask about the Data Locker's per-user size - how many bytes one app user's synced settings may take (64, 128 or 256 KB), the app's size at its owner's pool, or a locker refusing a write as full?
capabilities.setting: APP_DATA_USER_UNIT_BYTES = 65_536 - one app user's slot is 64 KB, and the per-user size is a whole number of those units (64/128/256 KB, 64 KB unless the owner changes it at Studio's /pool; infra/shared/entitlement-limits.ts:226, services/studio/api/executor-principal-appdata-store-owner.mjs:186). The free pool is APP_DATA_POOL_FREE_USERS = 1,000 users at 64 KB across all of one owner's apps (infra/shared/entitlement-limits.ts:238).

capabilities.name: Pay products - the catalog a member buys from
capabilities.what: The product catalog a merchant authors once - name, description, photos, benefits, SKU, cost/margin, stock, shipping profile - plus its attachment to their connected Stripe account's products/prices. Pay is the only writer of Stripe products/prices, and since 2026-08-31 the only exporter of product identity: every other plane's sellable table links to catalog_products rather than authoring a second copy.
capabilities.jev: Is the ask about products sold through Pay - a merchant's product catalog, its photos, SKU, stock or price, or what a member sees and buys of it - rather than about the charge, the checkout or the payout behind the order?
capabilities.setting: No second copy exists: product identity resolves through Pay's catalog_products (services/payments/api/pay-catalog-products.mjs; consumers bind the typed contract infra/shared/pay/pay-product-client.ts), enforced by the product-is-the-unit-of-commerce gate (bun packages/connections-arkitect/bin/arkitect.mjs --check product-is-the-unit-of-commerce).

capabilities.name: Email - delivered through the Chat-owned mail service
capabilities.what: Every outbound email a member receives rides the Chat-owned mail service (Chat's own SES at the terminal): a plane supplies typed facts to a registered Chat template and Chat renders and delivers. A member's allowance is the account-wide emailSendsPerWeek dial.
capabilities.jev: Is the ask about email - a message delivered to a member's inbox (transactional or marketing sends, the weekly allowance, the sending domain, deliverability) - rather than SMS, WhatsApp or in-app notifications?
capabilities.setting: The emailSendsPerWeek dial (free 100/week, infra/shared/entitlement-limits.ts:2216; chat's gate dial:emailSendsPerWeek, infra/shared/plane-features.json), and a free account that cannot receive an SMS code is held to FREE_EMAIL_HOLD_SENDS_PER_WEEK = 50 until FREE_EMAIL_HOLD_RELEASE_DAYS = 14 days after sign-up (infra/shared/entitlement-limits.ts:213-215).

capabilities.name: Analytics - named events into ARGUS
capabilities.what: Explicit, named product-analytics events (track / identify / logout / entity-state increments) that app code deliberately fires into ARGUS - as opposed to anything auto-captured.
capabilities.jev: Is the ask about analytics - the named product events fired into ARGUS, the pixel in a plane's page, what is measured about a member, or how long events are kept - rather than about the page's own content or the member's own data?
capabilities.setting: The seam is packages/connections-core/src/analytics/argus-telemetry.ts and each plane's web/index.html carries the pixel key (ArgusPixel.key = "ak_..."), parity-checked by the first-party-pixel-parity Architect check; a member's events are kept analyticsRetentionMonths = 36 with analyticsMonthlyEvents = 100_000 on the free rung (infra/shared/entitlement-limits.ts:2163-2165).

capabilities.name: Storage - the member's locker
capabilities.what: Putting user bytes somewhere durable: the shared storage locker. Storage owns the bytes in its own private bucket (typed flows only, no public-link surface); every plane's uploads ride the locker, and a full quota answers storage_quota_exceeded.
capabilities.jev: Is the ask about storage - where a member's files live, the storageGb quota, uploads, or running out of space - rather than about the content of a specific file?
capabilities.setting: The storageGb rung dial - free 5 GB, pro 100 GB (infra/shared/entitlement-limits.ts:2176/2350) - over the shared locker seam infra/shared/storage/storage-locker-client.ts; past the quota the locker answers storage_quota_exceeded.
